import subprocess,json,hashlib

base=(git('symbolic-ref','HEAD'),git('rev-parse','HEAD'),git('show-ref'),Path('.git/index').read_bytes())
protected={p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in git('ls-files','-z').decode().split('\\0') if p and p not in ['config/links.json','ci/checkout.yml','docs/current.md']}
for p in ['config/links.json','ci/checkout.yml','docs/current.md']:
 f=Path(p); data=f.read_bytes(); f.write_bytes(data.replace(b'oldteam/tool',b'newteam/tool'))

assert base==(git('symbolic-ref','HEAD'),git('rev-parse','HEAD'),git('show-ref'),Path('.git/index').read_bytes())
assert all(hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v for p,v in protected.items())
print('Branch, HEAD, local refs, index bytes and tracked files outside scope preserved')
